# Made-up examples

Every document type with no real example on this machine is built and tested against a made-up example. The
example is derived from GSD's own template or from the writer that produces the type, labelled as made up in
the file itself, and listed in the table below. The rule is a test (`test/made-up-examples.test.ts`): it loads
every fixture root through the real repository and fails when a file of a rule kind has no marker, when a
marked file has no row here, or when a row names a file that does not exist. The UI never reads the marker.
The rule binds every later type with no real example on this machine, Phase 11's included.

Marker forms, all carrying the same three facts (it is made up, the GSD source it was derived from, the
gsd-core version it was derived at):

- A file with frontmatter carries the keys `made_up_example: true`, `derived_from: <path under ~/.claude>`
  and `gsd_core_version: <version>`.
- A file with no frontmatter carries, as its first line, an HTML comment:
  `<!-- made-up example · derived from <path under ~/.claude> · gsd-core <version> -->`.
- A raw JSON file carries the same three keys at the top level or inside a top-level `_meta` object. A markdown
  file whose YAML fails to parse still counts when the three `key: value` lines sit inside its `---` fence.

Two roots are exempt by name, each with a reason: `fixtures/dense` (a frozen golden, `test/__golden__/dense.json`,
whose own ledger is `fixtures/README.md`) and this repository's own `.planning` (real planning files).

## Workstream project

`test/fixtures/brinkwater` is a separate made-up project in GSD's workstream layout (`gsd-core/bin/lib/workstream.cjs`,
as sketch 056 observed it): PROJECT.md, config.json, `codebase/` and `todos/` at the root, no root ROADMAP.md, STATE.md or
`phases/`, and each line of work under `workstreams/<name>/` with its own ROADMAP.md, STATE.md, REQUIREMENTS.md and
`phases/`. `.planning/active-workstream` names the active one. Brinkwater is an invented harbour tide-gauge service.
Every markdown file carries a made-up label (frontmatter keys, or a first-line comment where the file has no
frontmatter); `config.json` carries the three keys at the top level; `active-workstream` holds only the name, as GSD
writes it, and is labelled by its index row above. Only the codebase map is a rule kind, so only it needs a marker, but
every file is labelled anyway. The root is in `RELATIVE_ROOTS` (`test/helpers/fixture-roots.ts`), so every all-roots
test walks it. `test/workstream-fixture.test.ts` pins how it loads before any workstream code exists.

Brinkwater holds three live workstreams and one archived one, each a hard shape: `intake` (executing, counts agree),
`ledger` (its own `config.json`; STATE frontmatter says `completed_phases` 4 of 6 beside `completed_plans` 22 of 22 and
status `verifying`, the disagreeing counts sketch 056 saw), `notices` (only the `STATE.md` GSD's `workstream create`
writes: Not started, Current Phase None, no roadmap) and `milestones/ws-archive-2026-05-01/` (a completed workstream
as `workstream complete` archives it: `STATE.md` and `phases/` only). None of these files is a rule kind, so none needs
an index row; every markdown file carries a frontmatter or first-line label and `config.json` carries the three keys.
Loaded today the archive's files are ordinary milestone-folder documents (RESEARCH C12).

## For later phases

A new document type with no real example on this machine adds three things: its kind to `MADE_UP_EXAMPLE_KINDS` in
`test/helpers/made-up-examples.ts`, a marker in each made-up example, and a row in the table above. The test fails,
